text: きみは　いつでも　ボタンひとつで　おにいさんに　あえて　しまう！

structure.jp: おにいさんに　あえて　しまう！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says it happens fully, here in a playful way. あえてしまう = 'you can even meet me!'

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で shows the means or tool. ボタンひとつで = 'with just one button'.
